text: 很多视频有前三秒这种文字博取留存率，是不是也是一个技巧 (boss shared a TikTok example: on-screen text "DONT show this to a toothless fan👀" in the first frame, 102k likes, 9064 saves)

你记下来吧，属于爆款的某一点技巧 — boss classifies the first-3-seconds on-screen text hook (e.g. "DONT show this to a toothless fan👀": big one-line text from frame one, curiosity gap, readable muted, paired with an instant visual reaction) as one technique of viral videos; wants it kept as a viral technique.
还有个完播率的问题，很多视频故意勾着人们的悬念不放，持续或悬念结局在结尾 — boss notes a second viral technique for completion rate: hold the suspense through the whole video and only pay off (or reveal the ending) at the very end.

所以其实也是针对平台的规则，即什么条件会让视频继续推流 — boss frames the hook (first 3s retention) and end-suspense (completion rate) techniques as optimizing for the platform signals that decide whether a video keeps getting pushed to more viewers.

仔细研究研究它（Calmlings Instagram/Reels：深蓝小怪物戴耳机、干净桌面、顶部大字钩子「You can be more productive if you put music on」/「me:」），或者有没有其他同类的视频号了？他这个画面很干净，calm，可爱，信息没有过载 — boss taste: likes clean/calm/cute Pixar-toy 3D, soft lighting, one-line hook, no info overload; wants study of Calmlings and similar accounts.
或者其他品牌的，高播放量的 — boss wants other brands too (not only Calmlings lookalikes), with high view/play counts in the clean/calm/cute 3D lane.

Boss shared Calmlings Reels screenshot (cute dark-blue fluffy monster + headphones at clean wooden desk, soft cream bg, Pixar/toy-like 3D; hook: You can be more productive if you put music on / me:). Taste: 画面很干净、calm、可爱、信息没有过载. Asked careful study of what makes it work + other similar accounts/formats. Follow-up: also cover OTHER brands (not only Calmlings clones) with high play counts in same clean/calm/cute 3D lane.
音乐甚至可以自己做吧，这样结合了内容？ — boss idea: make original music ourselves so the score is fused with the content (not just a trending underlay).
